_help: The main story. Each saga has chapters; each chapter has goals. Goal types are listed in src/main/java/com/onepiecemod/story/StoryData.java. fruitTier = strongest boss fruit that leaves may drop during that saga.

chapters.title: A Hat and a Dream
chapters.intro: You wash up on a quiet beach with nothing but a dream: to find the One Piece. A boy in a straw hat lives in Foosha Village. Maybe he knows the way.

goals.text: Pick your race
Find Foosha Village
Bring Luffy the 16 steaks he's begging for

chapters.outro: "Shishishi! You're gonna be a great pirate. Go find Koby, he wants out of the Marines."

chapters.title: The Marine Who Wanted Out
chapters.intro: Koby swabs decks at the Shells Town Marine Base. Every pirate crew starts with a name and a first mate.

goals.text: Talk to Koby at Shells Town
Start your crew with /crew create <name>
Build a Pirate Tavern (/crew blueprint) and hire a swordsman there

chapters.outro: Your crew has a name now, and a sword at your side.

chapters.title: Set Sail
chapters.intro: No pirate stays on land. Build a Shipwright's Bench, make a Ship's Wheel, and take to the sea.

goals.text: Build a Shipwright's Bench
Make a Ship's Wheel at the bench
Sail 300 blocks in a boat or ship

chapters.outro: The wind fills your sails. East Blue is waiting.

chapters.title: Orange Town
chapters.intro: A clown called Buggy has taken over Orange Town, firing his Buggy Balls at anyone who laughs at his nose.

goals.text: Beat Buggy at his Big Top
Dig up a buried treasure (Buggy drops his treasure map)

chapters.outro: The Marines heard about it. You have your first bounty.

chapters.title: Syrup Village
chapters.intro: In Syrup Village lives a boy who tells tall tales and never misses a shot.

goals.text: Meet Usopp in Syrup Village
Hire a sniper
Sail your own ship 200 blocks (build a hull, place the Ship's Wheel, right-click it)

chapters.outro: Kaya gives you her gift: the Going Merry, with a sheep's head on the bow and the Straw Hat on her sail. Right-click deep sea to launch her.

chapters.title: The Baratie
chapters.intro: A floating restaurant where the cooks fight as hard as they cook. A crew that eats well sails far.

goals.text: Meet Sanji at the Baratie
Build a Ship's Galley
Hire a cook
Catch 2 kinds of fish (/fishlog)
Cook Sea Bream Sashimi at the Ship's Galley

chapters.outro: Sanji waves you off: "Learn Black Leg from me any time. Sneak and right-click."

chapters.title: Arlong Park
chapters.intro: Fish-Man pirates rule Cocoyasi Village from Arlong Park. A girl there draws the best sea charts in East Blue.

goals.text: Clear out 4 of Arlong's Fish-Men at Arlong Park
Meet Nami at Cocoyasi Village
Hire a navigator

chapters.outro: With a navigator aboard, you can build a Navigator's Desk and make Sea Charts and Log Poses.

chapters.title: Loguetown
chapters.intro: The town of the beginning and the end, where Gol D. Roger was executed. Captain Smoker of the Marines is waiting.

goals.text: Beat Smoker at the Loguetown Execution Square
Reach a bounty of 30,000,000 (Luffy's first bounty)

chapters.outro: Beating Smoker lets you make a Seastone Jitte at the Seastone Workbench. The Marines will hunt you harder now.

chapters.title: Reverse Mountain
chapters.intro: Compasses don't work in the Grand Line. Make a Log Pose, cross the Calm Belt where the Sea Kings nest, and find the lighthouse at the Twin Capes.

goals.text: Make a Log Pose at the Navigator's Desk
Cross the Calm Belt (watch out for Sea Kings)
Reach the Twin Capes Lighthouse
Record your first island with the Log Pose

chapters.outro: Welcome to the Grand Line, the pirate's graveyard.

chapters.title: Drum Island
chapters.intro: Your crew is hurt and no ship sails far without a doctor. On a snowy island, a reindeer runs a castle hospital.

goals.text: Meet Chopper at Drum Castle
Hire a doctor
Make a Rumble Ball at the Ship's Galley

chapters.title: Alabasta
chapters.intro: Sir Crocodile, a Warlord of the Sea, is drying up a whole kingdom from his casino, Rain Dinners.

goals.text: Visit Yuba Oasis
Visit Alubarna Palace
Beat Crocodile at Rain Dinners

chapters.outro: Rain falls on Alabasta for the first time in three years.

chapters.title: Sky Island
chapters.intro: Montblanc Cricket swears there's an island in the sky. Stand in his house and sneak: the Knock Up Stream will shoot you up there. A self-proclaimed god rules Shandora.

goals.text: Reach the sky ruins of Shandora
Beat Enel
Take on a crew in a Davy Back Fight, win or lose (Foxy waits at Long Ring Long Land)

chapters.outro: The golden bell of Shandora rings out over the clouds. You can ride the Knock Up Stream again any time.

chapters.title: Water 7 and Enies Lobby
chapters.intro: Your ship is falling apart. Water 7 has the best shipwrights in the world. But CP9 has taken a friend to the Tower of Justice.

goals.text: Meet Franky at the Galley-La Shipyard
Hire a shipwright
Beat Rob Lucci at the Tower of Justice

chapters.outro: You declared war on the World Government. Franky's gift waits in the harbour: the Thousand Sunny, built from Adam Wood. Right-click deep sea to launch her.

chapters.title: Thriller Bark
chapters.intro: A ghost ship drifts through the fog. Gecko Moria steals shadows there, and a skeleton with an afro wants his back.

goals.text: Beat Gecko Moria on Thriller Bark
Hire a musician

chapters.title: The Sabaody Archipelago
chapters.intro: A forest of giant mangroves at the foot of the Red Line, full of floating bubbles. Every rookie with a big bounty ends up here, and so do the World Nobles. At the Human Auctioning House, people are sold like goods.

goals.text: Reach the Sabaody Archipelago
Basil Hawkins reads your fate in his cards. Prove them wrong
Find the Human Auctioning House
You punched a Celestial Dragon! Fight off 4 waves of Marines (a Pacifista comes last)

chapters.outro: You walk out of the auction house with the Navy on your heels. An old man who was in the crowd says: 'Come to Shakky's bar. We should talk.'

chapters.title: Sabaody: The Dark King
chapters.intro: Silvers Rayleigh, the Dark King, was Gol D. Roger's first mate. He can coat your ship for the deep sea and tell you about Haki. But an Admiral is already on the island.

goals.text: Meet Silvers Rayleigh at Shakky's Rip-off Bar
Survive Kizaru's attack on Sabaody (stay alive 2 minutes)

chapters.outro: When you wake, you're on a strange island far from your crew. Rayleigh will train your Haki now: sneak and right-click him.

chapters.title: Amazon Lily
chapters.intro: You land on an island of warrior women ruled by the Pirate Empress. She doesn't like visitors.

goals.text: Reach Amazon Lily
Bring Boa Hancock the roses she wants

chapters.outro: Hancock agrees to sail you to Marineford.

chapters.title: Impel Down
chapters.intro: Ace has been taken to Impel Down, the great prison under the sea. Its lowest levels burn and freeze deep in the Nether. Build a Nether portal and break in. (Read the Sea Charts once you're in the Nether.)

goals.text: Break into Blazing Hell (Level 4)
Get through Freezing Hell (Level 5)
Find the hidden paradise of Newkama Land (Level 5.5)
Meet Emporio Ivankov in Newkama Land
Beat Chief Warden Magellan in Blazing Hell

chapters.outro: You escape Impel Down with half the prison behind you. Next stop: Marineford.

chapters.title: Marineford: The War Begins
chapters.intro: Fire Fist Ace stands on the execution platform. Whitebeard's fleet comes up through the bay, and the whole Navy waits for them. Fight your way onto the plaza: hold it against 5 waves of Marines and survive Akainu's magma.

goals.text: Hold Marineford against 5 waves of Marines

chapters.outro: The plaza is yours, but the platform is still far away. The Admirals have only just started.

chapters.title: The Paramount War
chapters.intro: The Navy raises its siege wall and the Pacifista march out. Kuzan freezes the bay so no one can run. Somewhere on the platform, Ace is waiting for someone to get there first.

goals.text: Break through to the execution platform: 4 waves of Vice Admirals and Pacifista (Akainu comes last, survive him)
Marco covers your retreat. Talk to him before you go
Have a bounty of at least 100,000,000 Berries

chapters.outro: Ace is free for a moment, and then he isn't. Whitebeard stands his ground until the end and tells the whole world: 'The One Piece is real!' A new era begins, and you are not strong enough for it yet.

chapters.title: Two Years of Training
chapters.intro: On Rusukaina the seasons change every week and the beasts are huge. Train until you're ready for the New World.

goals.text: Reach the Rusukaina Training Grounds
Armament Haki level 3
Observation Haki level 3
Learn a fighting style
Reach 300 Devil Fruit mastery, or learn a second fighting style

chapters.outro: Two years later, you're back. The New World is waiting.

chapters.title: Fish-Man Island
chapters.intro: The way to the New World runs 10,000 meters under the sea. Have your ship coated at Sabaody, take a submarine, or be a Fish-Man: the deep sea crushes anyone else.

goals.text: Dive down to the Ryugu Palace
Meet Jinbe
Hire a helmsman

chapters.outro: Jinbe warns you: Hody Jones and the New Fish-Man Pirates are planning something in the Fish-Man District.

chapters.title: The New Fish-Man Pirates
chapters.intro: Hody Jones hates humans more than Arlong ever did, and he takes Energy Steroids to grow strong. He wants to take the Ryugu Kingdom and drag every human down to the bottom of the sea. Queen Otohime gave her life for peace here.

goals.text: Go to the Fish-Man District
Defend the Ryugu Palace from 4 waves of the New Fish-Man Pirates
Beat Hody Jones at the Ryugu Palace (he comes for the king)

chapters.outro: Hody's steroids burn out and he falls. The Fish-Men and the humans who were watching stand on the same side for once. Jinbe will teach you Fish-Man Karate now: sneak and right-click him.

chapters.title: Punk Hazard
chapters.intro: Half fire, half ice. Trafalgar Law has a plan to take down an Emperor, and he needs your help.

goals.text: Reach the Punk Hazard Laboratory
Finish Law's first job

chapters.title: Dressrosa: The Corrida Colosseum
chapters.intro: The land of love, passion and toys. Doflamingo's Corrida Colosseum is giving away a real Devil Fruit to the winner: the Flame-Flame Fruit, Ace's fruit. A masked fighter called 'Lucy' isn't the only one who wants it.

goals.text: Reach the Corrida Colosseum
Win the Champion Cup at the Corrida Colosseum
A familiar face in a top hat is waiting backstage

chapters.outro: Sabo takes the Flame-Flame Fruit to keep it in the family. He tells you the toys of Dressrosa were people once, and the SMILE factory under the island is where Doflamingo makes his money.

chapters.title: The SMILE Factory
chapters.intro: Under the toy house, Doflamingo makes artificial Zoan fruit for Kaido. The toys who remember they were people are ready to fight. Destroy the factory and the Sugar who turns people into toys loses her hold.

goals.text: Break into the SMILE Factory
Wreck the factory: beat 4 waves of the Donquixote Family

chapters.outro: Every toy on the island turns back into a person at once, and they all remember. Doflamingo stops smiling, and drops a cage of strings over the whole country.

chapters.title: Dressrosa: The Birdcage
chapters.intro: The Birdcage of strings is closing in, cutting through everything it touches. Admiral Fujitora is here too, and he hasn't made up his mind. Fight up to the Royal Palace and break the cage.

goals.text: Fight up the palace through the Birdcage: 4 waves (Fujitora rolls the dice on the last, survive him)
Beat Donquixote Doflamingo at the Royal Palace

chapters.outro: The Birdcage falls apart, and Dressrosa is free. Fujitora bows to the people of Dressrosa on the front page of every paper in the world.

chapters.title: Zou
chapters.intro: A whole island on the back of a giant elephant. The Minks guard a red stone with ancient writing on it: a Road Poneglyph. Only an archaeologist can read it, and copying it takes Paper and Kraken Ink (Krakens live in the deep ocean).

goals.text: Hire an archaeologist
Copy the Road Poneglyph at Mokomo Dukedom (right-click it with Paper and Kraken Ink)

chapters.outro: One of four. The other three are guarded by Emperors.

chapters.title: Totto Land
chapters.intro: Big Mom's country of sweets and talking homies. Her daughter is to marry Vinsmoke Sanji at a Tea Party, and Sanji doesn't look happy about it.

goals.text: Reach Chocolate Town on Cacao Island
Find Sanji in Chocolate Town
Sneak into Whole Cake Chateau

chapters.outro: Sanji says he's going through with the wedding to save the Baratie. Nobody believes him. The Tea Party starts tomorrow.

chapters.title: The Tea Party
chapters.intro: The whole Charlotte family sits at the Tea Party, and Big Mom's Road Poneglyph is hidden in the chateau. Copy it while everyone is busy, then crash the party.

goals.text: Copy the Road Poneglyph in Whole Cake Chateau
Crash the Tea Party: 4 waves of Big Mom Pirates (Big Mom herself comes last, survive her)

chapters.outro: Big Mom screams for the photo of Mother Caramel and the chateau shakes apart. You run, with the whole Charlotte family behind you. Katakuri is waiting at the shore.

chapters.title: Whole Cake Island: The Escape
chapters.intro: Big Mom's strongest son, Katakuri, can see the future. He traps you in the Mirror World. Beat him, then stand up to his mother.

goals.text: Beat Charlotte Katakuri in the Mirror Hall
Beat Big Mom at Whole Cake Chateau

chapters.outro: Big Mom's Road Poneglyph is copied. Two of four. The third is in Wano, a country closed to the world.

chapters.title: The Land of Wano
chapters.intro: A waterfall climbs to a closed country of samurai. Twenty years ago Kaido and Orochi killed Kozuki Oden and took Wano. In Ebisu Town the poor laugh because Kaido's SMILE fruit took away their tears. Find Oden's old retainers.

goals.text: Reach Ebisu Town in Wano
Meet Kin'emon in the Flower Capital
Find Yamato at the old samurai house. Kaido's own child wants Wano free

chapters.outro: Kin'emon gathers the Red Scabbards. But many allies sit in Udon's prison mine, and Queen guards them.

chapters.title: Udon Prison
chapters.intro: Kaido's prisoners dig in the mines of Udon and starve on a bowl of soup a day. Free them and they'll fight for Wano. Queen the Plague, one of Kaido's three All-Stars, is coming to stop the riot.

goals.text: Break into the Udon Prisoner Mine
Beat Queen the Plague at Udon (he comes once you're in)

chapters.outro: Udon's prisoners take the mine and join the raid. Thousands now march on Onigashima.

chapters.title: The Raid on Onigashima
chapters.intro: The Fire Festival night. Kaido's whole crew is drinking on Onigashima. Storm the island, cut through the Beast Pirates, and climb to the rooftop where Kaido waits.

goals.text: Storm Onigashima: beat 4 waves of Beast Pirates
Beat King at his Flame Fortress
Beat Kaido on Onigashima
Copy the Road Poneglyph on Onigashima

chapters.outro: The dawn bell rings over a free Wano, and its Road Poneglyph is yours. Three of four. Your Devil Fruit can awaken now. In Oden's old castle you find his log: a page of the true history.

chapters.title: Egghead, Island of the Future
chapters.intro: Dr. Vegapunk has moved his lab to Egghead, a future island hidden in a winter cloud. He wants to meet you, and the World Government wants him dead. CP0 is already on the island.

goals.text: Reach Egghead Labophase
Meet Dr. Vegapunk at Labophase (he comes to meet you)
Beat Rob Lucci on Hard. CP0's Awakened leopard came for Vegapunk

chapters.outro: Lucci falls, but the news reaches Mary Geoise. A Buster Call fleet and a Gorosei are on their way.

chapters.title: The Egghead Incident
chapters.intro: The Navy surrounds Egghead. Pacifista and the Seraphim, children of Vegapunk's own science, turn on him, and Admiral Kizaru leads them. Hold Labophase while Vegapunk records his message to the world.

goals.text: Hold Labophase against 4 waves (Kizaru joins the last)
Beat Saint Jaygarcia Saturn, the Gorosei who came in person

chapters.outro: Every Den Den Mushi in the world starts to speak with Vegapunk's voice: the sea is rising, and the truth was hidden for 800 years. You sail out of the Navy's ring of ships with the broadcast still going. Your Den Den Mushi recorded every word: a page of the true history.

chapters.title: Elbaph, Land of the Giants
chapters.intro: Egghead's broadcast is still echoing over the sea when a giant warship takes you aboard. Dorry and Brogy's homeland is the next stop: Elbaph, an island grown from one tree so big its roots reach the sea floor. Shanks has been waiting there for you.

goals.text: Climb the Great Tree of Elbaph
Find Shanks under the Great Tree. He has a drink ready
Read the giants' oldest Poneglyph under the Great Tree (bring your archaeologist)

chapters.outro: The giants roar out a song about the Sun God. Shanks just listens, then looks out to sea. "White sails. I knew they'd come."

chapters.title: The Holy Knights
chapters.intro: The World Government sends its own knights, the Holy Knights of Mary Geoise, to punish Elbaph for remembering Joy Boy. Saint Gunko leads the first attack. Behind her comes their commander, Figarland Shamrock, with the same red hair as Shanks and a sword called Cerberus.

goals.text: Hold the Great Tree against 4 waves of Holy Knights, CP0 and Seraphim
Beat Saint Gunko of the Holy Knights
Beat Figarland Shamrock, commander of the Holy Knights (watch out for Cerberus)

chapters.outro: Shamrock wipes the blood from his lip and calls Cerberus back to his side. "Brother... so this is who you picked. The Holy Land will see you soon." The Holy Knights sail away. The giants of Elbaph offer to stand with you at the end, like they once stood with Joy Boy.

chapters.title: Hachinosu
chapters.intro: With Elbaph behind you, one Road Poneglyph is left. Blackbeard holds it on Pirate Island. He has two Devil Fruits and no mercy.

goals.text: Beat Marshall D. Teach on Hachinosu
Copy the Road Poneglyph on Hachinosu

chapters.outro: Four of four. Your archaeologist lays the rubbings side by side and finds the place where all four point.

chapters.title: The Road to Laugh Tale
chapters.intro: Four red stones, four sets of coordinates. Lay the rubbings side by side and your archaeologist can find the one island nobody has reached since Roger.

goals.text: Carry the Zou rubbing
Carry the Whole Cake rubbing
Carry the Wano rubbing
Carry the Hachinosu rubbing

chapters.outro: Your archaeologist draws four lines across the chart. They cross at a speck of ocean that is not on any map. Roger's crew laughed when they got there. You're about to find out why. But you're not the only one who knows the way: Blackbeard copied the same stones.

chapters.title: Laugh Tale
chapters.intro: The last island. Blackbeard is right behind you, the Ancient Guardians watch the shore, and a man is waiting at the end of the world.

goals.text: Reach Laugh Tale
Hold the shore against 4 waves of Blackbeard Pirates (Teach joins the last)
Talk to Gol D. Roger

chapters.outro: Roger laughs until he cries. "So you found it. Wahahaha! What a funny story..."

chapters.title: The Red Line
chapters.intro: You found the One Piece, but Roger's treasure raised more questions than it answered. The answers are on the Red Line, where the World Nobles live above the clouds. Find a stronghold and its End portal. Read the Sea Chart once you're in the End.

goals.text: Reach a Celestial Dragon's mansion on the Red Line
Read 4 pages of the true history on Poneglyphs (/endgame history)

chapters.title: The Void Century
chapters.intro: Somewhere on the heights lie ruins from the hundred years the World Government erased from history. Read the Sea Chart once you're in the End.

goals.text: Find the Void Century ruins
Read 12 pages of the true history (Poneglyphs, Oden's log and Vegapunk's broadcast; /endgame history)

chapters.outro: The stone tells of a great kingdom, and of the twenty kings who destroyed it. One of the twenty is still up there, on the throne.

chapters.title: The Gates of the Holy Land
chapters.intro: Shamrock told you to come, so you did. The Holy Knights guard Pangaea Castle, and behind them waits the one who sends them. Read the Sea Chart once you're in the End.

goals.text: Reach the gates of Pangaea Castle
Break through 4 waves of Holy Knights at the castle gates
Beat Shamrock again, on Hard. He and Cerberus won't let you pass a second time

chapters.outro: Shamrock kneels at last. "Go on, then. See what we've been guarding." The throne room doors are open.

chapters.title: The Empty Throne
chapters.intro: In Pangaea Castle stands a throne no one may sit on. But someone does.

goals.text: Enter Pangaea Castle
Beat Imu on the Empty Throne

chapters.outro: The world will never be the same. Under the throne lies the last page of the true history. Take it back to Laugh Tale.

chapters.title: The Dawn of the World
chapters.intro: The pages of the true history are scattered over the world's Poneglyphs (type /endgame history to see which you still need). Gather all thirteen, then sail back to Laugh Tale and let your archaeologist read the last stone with the whole story beside it.

goals.text: Gather all 13 pages of the true history
Read the last Poneglyph at Laugh Tale

chapters.outro: The drums are still sounding. Joy Boy's promise is kept, eight hundred years late.
